previously_divergent_sites.query:
SELECT r.symbol_id, r.strategy, r.reference_name
FROM refs r JOIN files f ON f.id=r.file_id
JOIN symbols enclosing ON enclosing.id=r.in_symbol_id
LEFT JOIN symbols target ON target.id=r.symbol_id
WHERE f.path IN (?, ?) AND r.kind=? AND r.line=? AND r.column=?
AND enclosing.qualified_name=? AND (r.reference_name=? OR target.qualified_name=?)
previously_divergent_sites.selection_note: Chained C# calls can share start coordinates and have unset end spans; reference/target name disambiguates the witness from unrelated calls at that position.
